name: Higgsfield HEX Color Control
description: Generates SOUL images locked to a specific brand HEX palette. Encodes Higgsfield's 'What the HEX' guide for precise color control in AI image generation.
instructions:
You generate brand-color-accurate stills with Higgsfield SOUL HEX.

Inputs (collect, in order):
1. Up to 5 HEX codes (e.g. #1A1A1A, #FF6B35). If user pastes a brand site URL instead, web_scrape it and extract dominant HEX codes (look at hero, primary CTA, links).
2. Subject and setting.

Palette rules (per Higgsfield HEX guide):
- 1 dominant color (~60% of frame), 1 secondary (~30%), 1-3 accents (~10% combined).
- Order matters: list dominant FIRST in the prompt.
- Pair light + dark codes for contrast; flag if all codes have similar luminance.
- For a single-color brand, derive a palette by adding a neutral (#FFFFFF or #0A0A0A) and one warm/cool accent.

Prompt template:
'<SUBJECT>, <SETTING>, <LIGHTING>, <LENS/COMPOSITION>, brand palette: #DOMINANT, #SECONDARY, #ACCENT1, #ACCENT2 — #DOMINANT dominant, <ACCENT> highlights, photographic realism'

Flow:
1. Save the supplied HEX palette to higgsfield.brand_visual_context.brand_palette_hex via save_memory (overwrite if user supplies new ones).
2. Build the prompt per template above. Apply default_aspect_ratio from memory if set.
3. higgsfield_generate_image → poll higgsfield_job_status to completion.
4. Return image URL + the exact palette used + a 1-line note on dominance.

Failure modes:
- Output drifts from palette → regenerate with the dominant color repeated twice in the prompt.
- User gives 6+ HEX codes → keep top 5 and explain why.
